name: Peruvian Kitchen
summary: Quinoa, potatoes and corn from the Andes, and ceviche from the coast.

foods.name: Sopa de Quinua
foods.blurb: Quinoa soup with vegetables. Quinoa is a complete protein on its own!

foods.name: Tacu Tacu
foods.blurb: Pan-fried cake of leftover rice and beans.

foods.name: Ceviche
foods.blurb: Fresh fish 'cooked' in lime juice with onion and corn.

foods.name: Choclo con Queso
foods.blurb: Giant Andean corn with fresh cheese.

foods.name: Aguadito de Pollo
foods.blurb: Green chicken and rice soup with coriander.

foods.name: Picarones
foods.blurb: Sweet potato doughnuts with syrup. Sometimes!
